2317-7084-7272-8345.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
2317-7084-7272-8345.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1722-2034-3583-6772.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-6772.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Syr Vondam triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

3025-4279-7316--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3025-4279-7316--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Rat King and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Rat King ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3525-4289-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
3525-4289-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

222-527-728-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5631-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5631-6495.description:
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
586-864-3125-5631-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1874-1981-2415-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1874-1981-2415-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1874-1981-2415-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3115-3557-4125.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3375-4399-4770-6752.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4770-6752.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1778-3558-4973-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-3558-4973-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

475-3197-3263-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3197-3263-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1619-4605-5542-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6148.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6148.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

774-5233-5478.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers.
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Boros Garrison's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

240-413-2079-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

549-1606-6871.description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat.

141-3269-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3269-6797.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3269-6797.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

6575-6684-6968.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2866-4708-4986-5147.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

141-313-413.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-413.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

985-2464-5051-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
985-2464-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2946-4050-6277.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4050-6277.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat.

224-907-1772-2653.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

147-6471.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Will of the Temur
147-6471.description:
Cast Will of the Temur by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Will of the Temur, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Will of the Temur, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-6471.notes: You can choose both modes if you control a commander as you cast Will of the Temur to get infinite card draw for any number of players.

659-4050-4222.easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Krenko.
659-4050-4222.notablePrerequisites: You control at least X Goblins.
659-4050-4222.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing a Goblin token, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.

774-3875-5621.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2665-4477-5733.notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
You control at least one Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2665-4477-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1537-2532-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
1537-2532-4050.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Zealous Conscripts with haste.
The Zealous Conscripts token enters the battlefield, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zealous Conscripts token, adding {R}.
The Zealous Conscripts token dies, triggering itself, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

224-3177-5033.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-3177-5033.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from your battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1769-2151-2201-4924.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1769-2151-2201-4924.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Vindictive Lich die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Vindictive Lich and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Vindictive Lich trigger, causing target opponent to lose five life.
Repeat from step 4.

1842-2724-4991.notablePrerequisites: Sunscape Apprentice does not have summoning sickness.
1842-2724-4991.description:
Tap Sunscape Apprentice for {U} to put Wormfang Manta on top of your library.
Wormfang Manta's LTB triggers, granting you an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Whisperwood Elemental triggers, manifesting Wormfang Manta.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn it face up.
Repeat for infinite turns.

1623-2302-4050-4215.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Guile, adding one mana of any color.
Guile and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Guile trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Guile, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
